name: When is the best time of year to address window condensation problems?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time of year to address window condensation problems?

acceptedAnswer.text: Window condensation problems can be addressed at any time, but cooler, wetter months (fall and winter) in the Bay Area often highlight these issues more prominently due to greater temperature differences between indoors and outdoors, and increased indoor heating. This can be a good time to identify the severity of the problem. However, repairs or replacements can typically be scheduled year-round. It's often strategic to plan for glass unit replacements during milder weather to minimize disruption and maintain indoor comfort.
acceptedAnswer.description: Condensation problems are often more noticeable in cooler months, but repairs or replacements can be done year-round.
